content.text: Almost. Most babies start solids around 6 months, and Theo's 5 months now. A month from now, look for the readiness signs: sitting up with little help, good head control, and reaching for your food. Until then, breast milk or formula is still all he needs. Start with one iron-rich food, like iron-fortified cereal or well-mashed meat, once a day. Confirm the timing with your provider or public health.
